title: Scope Base-only naming SessionBind retries to one attempt and recover invalid tokens
outcome: Base-only naming does not reuse a superseded SessionBind reply across distinct binding attempts, and can safely recover a definitively invalid routing token without enabling turn admission.
acceptance: A deterministic regression using the stateful SessionBind model distinguishes same-attempt lost-reply replay from a subsequent bind attempt after token rotation/local token loss with unchanged claim association; report separately whether the live engine contract is verified.

Any attempt identity and invalid-token recovery preserve exact store/claim/run/fence/runtime/owner checks and unknown-outcome replay; no grant, turn admission, host-credit or acceptance prerequisite is introduced.
disposal_reason: Obsolete. Its subject, SessionBind, is no longer in production code: 87f49ed0 removed turn-gated control and SessionBind. Verified by Opus3's read-only sweep at master 57a762c8 (TermAl mailbox 03723eab #5238); cancelled by coordinator Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13.
